## Earnie 2.5.3-alpha.2

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5.3** line (follow-up to `2.5.3-alpha.1`). Focus: EV EHAL binding safety and SonarCloud leak-period remediations.

### Highlights

- **EV EHAL binding collisions** — Loxone verify warns when distinct EV roles share one Merker; EHAL-Com label `Setpoint Wallbox-Sollstrom (A)`
- **SonarCloud debt** — secrets via `env:` in HA add-on / release workflows; Dev Container non-root `vscode` + `pip --only-binary=:all:`
- Accepted: Release workflow keeps floating action tags (SHA pins blocked tag runs)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3-alpha.2` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.2**).
